correctness.rationale: Exact joint shift D=sum_{a=1}^R T_{K_a} follows bijectively by deleting obligatory nonoverlined copies, leaving distinguished overlines unchanged. Uniform Engel overpartition ratios for D≤C sqrt(N) give the multivariate exp(-π/4 sum of squared maximal thresholds) survivor and independent-Rayleigh running-minimum vector law. Exact tie decomposition sum_{j≥1}[pbar(N-sT_{j-1})-pbar(N-sT_{j-1}-rj)] follows from requiring s copies below j and fewer than r at j. For j≤K N^(1/4), quantitative expansion makes each difference a Gaussian-weighted rj/√N term plus O(N^-1/2); O(N^(1/4)) terms produce vanishing total error and a Riemann sum r/s(1-exp(-πsK²/4)). The tail is bounded by P(M_s>KN^(1/4))→exp(-πsK²/4); K→∞ proves every fixed r<s tie limit. Independent Python enumerated all overpartitions up to weight 12, checked 78 simultaneous tail identities and 65 tie identities, and coefficient trends up to weight 3000, not used as infinite proof.
